subject.title: Dashboard: export / import / share a workspace config

question: Should dashboard workspace import/export/share be sponsored as bundled dashboard plugin work after the Wave 1 stack lands, or should distribution live first as an external plugin or ClawHub package?
rationale: The feature is aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it depends on an unmerged dashboard surface and crosses storage, portable artifact, sandbox, and custom-widget approval boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Sponsor After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 4 distribution child and require storage, validation, and security proof once the dashboard foundation is accepted.

options.title: Externalize Distribution First
options.body: Ask contributors to prove workspace package import/export as an external plugin or ClawHub package until maintainers accept bundled dashboard scope.

options.title: Defer Sharing
options.body: Leave the roadmap child open but do not start implementation until the base dashboard and custom-widget approval flow are accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 4 distribution child and require storage, validation, and security proof once the dashboard foundation is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main ownership signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and is the best available routing owner for bundled dashboard scope.
